results.title: Alexander the Great and the Accursed Dragon
results.original_title: Ο Μεγαλέξανδρος και ο καταραμένος δράκος
results.overview: In Karagiozis's dream, a man‑eating Dragon seizes control of the city's aqueduct. In order to prevent panic, Rigas persuades him to accept his victims by lottery. When the lot falls on Rigopoula, twelve‑year‑old Alexandre, searching for the horse he adores, unexpectedly comes upon the Dragon. He does not panic. Selfless love completely conquers fear.

results.title: Worthy
results.overview: The discovery of an icon, which Ilias believes to be crying, sets him on his journey from cemetery caretaker to the chosen one. While he is on his quest to bring the icon to the people of the small town, we also follow three other stories of people who could do with a little help from a miraculous icon.

results.title: Grace Comes Crashing
results.overview: As a strange red lichen spreads across the countryside, Geryon confronts the emergence of sexual desire and an animal metamorphosis that drives him to flee into the mountains.

results.title: Inventario de invisibles
results.overview: The project was developed in collaboration with scientists from CONICET and the National University of the Northeast, who have been conducting research in the area for over four decades. Together with them, we delved into the thresholds of other geological eras, exploring interspecies coexistence and dialogues.

results.title: Only Old Friends Left Alive
results.overview: Retired Lao Cao and Xiao Lai, two old men, sit on opposite sides of a drinking table under an arcade in Taipei. They toast and talk nonsense like this every day, and they have done it for more than thirty years. A young director who meant only to watch somehow ends up at the table too, spending many absurd and moving nights with them. Years pass. Someone leaves, someone falls ill, and some relationships are repaired and then break again. The two men are old, they are nearly done with drink, and they no longer see each other often.

results.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.original_title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

results.title: Home
results.overview: Where does the Ukrainian road home begin and where does it end? The poetic journey follows a Ukrainian actress, Yelyzaveta, who emigrated to Lithuania, traveling back to her homeland country ravaged by war. Will we reach the final destination? How to reach home? Relatives? How to get back to the past which no longer exists? Can we wake up from the dream?

results.title: The Torch
results.overview: Meira foregrounds the historic and continuing resistance of the Meira Paibi, “women with torches” of Manipur. Emerging in response to the pervasive climate of fear produced by the enforcement of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958, the film traces how ordinary women transformed themselves into vigilant custodians of their communities. Meira situates the movement within a longer genealogy of women-led resistance in Manipur.

results.title: The Girl Beneath The Sun
results.overview: Teenage sugarcane harvester Shivkanya confronts the realities of early motherhood and marriage, unspoken duties, an eccentric  husband and an uncertain future that shapes and  constrains her dreams, identity and hopes for her child and herself.

results.title: For Lack of a Better World
results.original_title: For Lack of a Better World
results.overview: An experimental documentary short exploring how our sense of self is reshaped through conversations with machines. Through the lived experience of people in India speaking to AI, the film captures a fragile moment in which intimacy, care, and vulnerability are quietly shifting away from human bonds and toward artificial companionship. What happens when we train a machine to understand us better than we understand ourselves? Though these exchanges take place in private, the voices reveal something collective.

results.title: A Sunflower in Delhi
results.overview: In a tiny women’s only beauty parlour, generations of devoted customers, including the filmmaker’s family, reflect on letting their hair go grey. The film meanders between the intimate oasis of the Sunflower Chinese Beauty Parlour and the bustling city landscape outside.
